summary: This clinical trial is testing a medicine called petrelintide for adults who have overweight or obesity and Type 2 Diabetes, which is a condition where the body has trouble handling blood sugar. The study is currently Recruiting and plans to enroll 600 participants. Hoffmann-La Roche is sponsoring this Phase 3 trial to see how well the treatment works compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine.
